segments.comment: Abandoned A36 admission probe retained with its matching recording: the leading space is consumed as an unknown command, then ; reaches the production blind quick-glance prompt, but the final . remains at its --More-- boundary. It does not establish location selection or description parity. The valid selected-location input is retained separately as blind-glance-description-blocked-independent.session.json, blocked by the existing JS ttyPutmixed versus C putmixed(WIN_MESSAGE) owner.
